role: The stronghold generator: three ring positions drawn once from new Random(worldSeed) and nudged to a biome with positive min height, a start only at those chunks, rebuilt until it contains a portal room; also the coordinate list eyes of ender fall back to.
scope_reason: Strongholds are vanilla worldgen and on (SPEC Decisions).

notes: Java uses StrictMath.cos/sin for the ring; stronghold.c uses libm cos/sin. They agree on every recorded seed (s2, s42, shs-*), but this is not proven for all angles and is a GPU-port hazard too. stronghold.c keeps the ring and a biome box cache in static mutable state (sh_coords, sh_layers, sh_box) with a malloc in gen_box. Gate not re-run for this record.
